description: Fetch the current published value for a FLOPS compute price index. Returns {value, unit, as_of, data_tier, confidence, verify_url, citation_url}. Cheapest way to answer 'what is the latest public reference price for X?' (refreshed every 6 hours). Confidence is a label (HIGH or MED), never a numeric weight. Carries no methodology or source attribution by design — the anonymous surface does not enumerate the tiers or families it withholds.

slug.description: FLOPS index slug. Accepts FLOPS-<MODEL>-OD, FLOPS-<MODEL>-SPOT, FLOPS-<MODEL>-DEPIN, or a bare gpu_model.

name: get_price
title: Get a FLOPS index price
